children: Indonesia’s loan growth rose 13.26% year-on-year in September 2026, following a 13.36% increase in August, marking the slowest growth since June.
By usage, the latest result was led by investment loans, which grew 23.2%, followed by working capital loans (11.89%) and consumer loans (4.86%).
The central bank expects loan growth to reach 8–12% for the full year, reflecting its accommodative macroprudential stance to support the economy.

title: Indonesia Loan Growth Eases to 3-Month Low
